title: Financial Stability Report
summary: The Bank of Canada's May 2025 Financial Stability Report—available only as a metadata summary at this time—states that Canada's financial system is resilient after successfully weathering the pandemic, elevated inflation, and sharp interest rate increases. However, an ongoing trade war is identified as a threat to the Canadian economy and poses risks to financial stability.

The system successfully navigated the pandemic, elevated inflation period, and sharp interest rate increases
A trade war is identified as a current threat to the Canadian economy
The trade war poses risks to financial stability according to the Bank of Canada
The report was authored by Tiff Macklem, Carolyn Rogers, Toni Gravelle, Sharon Kozicki, Rhys R. Mendes, Nicolas Vincent, and Michelle Alexopoulos
